situation: How to connect GLM models to many MCP servers.
decision: Do NOT wire one GLM model directly to every MCP server. Use a governed MCP gateway + policy engine that shares a stable tool catalog while routing perception, reasoning, and generation to different GLM models.
reasoning_physics: Direct connections multiply integration surface and duplicate auth/caching per model. A single gateway centralizes the stable tool registry and policy, so one canonical catalog serves all models without N×M rewiring.
